name: Crystal
note: Ruby-like syntax, compiled and statically typed
typeSystem: Static, strong, fully inferred (Ruby-like syntax with no annotations required in most code), with union types and generics checked entirely at compile time despite looking like a dynamic scripting language.
runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time to native code via LLVM, with automatic memory management via the Boehm garbage collector.

runtimes.name: Native (LLVM)
runtimes.role: AOT compiled; memory managed by the Boehm garbage collector.

compilers.name: crystal
compilers.role: The reference self-hosted compiler, built on LLVM.

concurrencyModel: Lightweight cooperative fibers communicate through channels. Programs are concurrent but default to parallelism 1; current releases provide execution contexts that can be resized or added to opt into parallel execution across OS threads.
